name: context-window-exceeded
why: `stop_reason: model_context_window_exceeded` — a hard failure with no retry, because re-sending an identical oversize request only spends again.

provenance.why_not_recorded: Unreachable at the shipped slice size: `MAX_REQUEST_BYTES` refuses an oversized request before it is sent, so the response can only occur if the per-page token constant is wrong. The branch guards a pinakes defect, not an API behaviour.
